title: Revelation
lyrics_original: Worthy is the Lamb who was slain
Holy, holy is He
Sing a new song to Him who sits on
Heaven's mercy seat
Worthy is the Lamb who was slain
Holy, holy is He
Sing a new song to Him who sits on
Heaven's mercy seat
Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty
Who was and is and is to come
With all creation I sing praise to the King of kings
You are my everything and I will adore You
Clothed in rainbows of living color
Flashes of lighting rolls of thunder
Blessing and honor strength and glory and power be
To You the only wise King
Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty
Who was and is and is to come
With all creation I sing praise to the King of kings
You are my everything and I will adore You
Filled with wonder awestruck wonder
At the mention of Your name
Jesus Your name is power, breath and living water
Such a marvelous mystery
Oh, You're worthy, mystery
You are worthy
Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty
Who was and is and is to come
With all creation I sing praise to the King of kings
You are my everything and I will adore You, I will adore You

bible_verses.telugu: వారువధింపబడిన గొఱ్ఱపిల్ల, శక్తియు ఐశ్వర్యమును జ్ఞానమును బలమును ఘనతయు మహిమయు స్తోత్రమును పొందనర్హుడని గొప్ప స్వరముతో చెప్పుచుండిరి.
bible_verses.english: In a loud voice they were saying: 'Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and praise!'

bible_verses.telugu: ఈ నాలుగు జీవులలో ప్రతి జీవికి ఆరేసి రెక్కలుండెను, అవి చుట్టును రెక్కల లోపటను కన్నులతో నిండియున్నవి. అవిభూతవర్తమాన భవిష్యత్కాలములలో ఉండు సర్వాధికారియు దేవుడునగు ప్రభువు పరిశుద్ధుడు, పరిశుద్ధుడు, పరిశుద్ధుడు, అని మానక రాత్రింబగళ్లు చెప్పుచుండును.
bible_verses.english: Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around, even under its wings. Day and night they never stop saying: '“Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty,” who was, and is, and is to come.'

bible_verses.telugu: ఆ పెద్దలునీవు ఆ గ్రంథమును తీసికొని దాని ముద్రలను విప్పుటకు యోగ్యుడవు, నీవు వధింపబడినవాడవై నీ రక్తమిచ్చి, ప్రతి వంశములోను, ఆయా భాషలు మాటలాడువారిలోను, ప్రతి ప్రజలోను, ప్రతి జనములోను, దేవునికొరకు మనుష్యులను కొని,
bible_verses.english: And they sang a new song, saying: 'You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, because you were slain, and with your blood you purchased for God persons from every tribe and language and people and nation.'

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God Almighty, You alone are holy, faithful, and worthy of all praise. Thank You, Jesus, for being the Lamb who was slain for my sake, opening the way for me to approach Your mercy seat with confidence. Fill my heart today with awe at Your eternal greatness. May my life be a living song of gratitude to You, the One who holds my past, present, and future. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God Almighty, You alone are holy, faithful, and worthy of all praise. devotional.reflection_english: When we fix our eyes on the throne of God, our earthly worries fade in light of His eternal holy presence. Jesus, the Lamb who was slain, sacrificed everything to bring us near, proving Himself forever worthy of our adoration. Singing a new song is our heart's spontaneous response to His unchanging grace and majesty. Today, step into this heavenly worship and let your spirit rest in the One who was, who is, and who is to come.
